feeds.title: Lady Jane's Naturals Blog
feeds.description: Get ready to dabble in the world of Cannabis Topicals. This blog is your guide to the right cannabis enjoyment path! Lady Jane's Naturals LLC is a local woman-owned medical cannabis dispensary offering a variety of cannabis products to support the well-being of patients in Tulsa and the surrounding areas.

feeds.title: WOMEN + WEED Blog
feeds.description: Women + Weed is an organization, whose mission is to break the stigma surrounding Cannabis and Plant medicine, through education and networking. Their blog aims to be your go-to source for cannabis knowledge, from strain guides and product reviews to legalization news and exploring the iconic Tulsa weed scene.
